note: constants = exported constants of the runtime copies, regenerated by tools/extract_garment_parameters.mjs (a test fails on drift). subjectLiterals = hand-read literals; class subject = tied to the reference character asset (coordinates, mesh/outfit names, texture hue bands) and must be re-derived or re-confirmed for another character; class behaviour = solver/UI behaviour or vocabulary. `literal` is a verbatim substring of the cited line (checked by tests/test_garment_character_manifest.py). Files are relative to runtime/garment-character/. Not claimed exhaustive for non-coordinate numbers.

subjectLiterals.meaning: OUTFITS: outfit ids; green = the painted source colorway, orange = the hue-shifted variant (recolorPixels). Colorway choice of this asset.

STRAP.yAttach: model-space y (m) where the halter ribbon leaves the cup apex; source comment (l.12-13): "measured on the delivered BikiniTop". Drives strapCoordinate, pinned-band selection, shader ribbon gate and cut position.
STRAP.yTop: model-space y (m) where the ribbon reaches the neck loop; s runs 0..1 between yAttach and yTop.
STRAP.maxAbsX: ribbon vertices have |x| <= this (source comment: |x| <= 0.083 m measured).
STRAP.minZ: ribbon vertices have z >= this (source comment: z >= -0.02 m measured); +Z is the asset front.
SUBSTEP: fixed spring sub-step in seconds.
CHEST map: strap/cup side +1 (x >= 0 in strapCoordinate) is the region id chest-left. Region vocabulary from softbody REGION_IDS; the +x = left convention is read from the code only.
CHEST map: side -1 (x < 0) is the region id chest-right.
FALL_TOUCHDOWN: fraction of the fall window at which the flap touches down (ease-in square).
fallProfile bounce amplitude after touchdown.
recolorPixels: hue (deg) rising edge 85..105 of the painted green fabric that gets re-hued (doc comment l.115 says "painted green fabric"); texture-specific.
recolorPixels: hue (deg) falling edge 195..215 closing the re-hued band; texture-specific.
recolorPixels: saturation ramp 0.08..0.3 below which pixels (white stripes, line work) are untouched.
recolorPixels: target hue 22 deg (orange) of the variant colorway; also x1.05 saturation and x1.18 value on the same line.
Shader gRibbon gate: |aRest.x| < 0.1 (m) together with y >= STRAP.yAttach marks ribbon fragments (x half-width, differs from STRAP.maxAbsX 0.085).
Shader spark width (m, along y) around the cut edge.
Shader noise frequency on aRest in the recolor wave edge.
Shader noise amplitude (m) on the recolor wave distance.
Glow colour mixed into the recolor wave and release/reseat flashes.
Hard-coded mesh name of the skin mesh that cloth contact projects onto (rig.meshes.get).
Error text naming the two required soft meshes (garment mesh name is also passed in via the `bikini` argument; viewer.mjs l.61 selects it by name).
Initial recolor span; replaced by the measured farthest-vertex distance in buildContact.
Three.js programCacheKey; names the garment shader revision.

subjectLiterals.literal: BikiniTop has no painted color map
subjectLiterals.meaning: Error text; garment is expected to carry a painted colour map.
uOrigin: recolor wave origin in garment rest coordinates (x=0, y=1.47, z=0.04), used as distance(aRest, uOrigin). Anatomical meaning is unverified (y=1.47 lies between STRAP.yAttach and STRAP.yTop).
Fraction (10 %) of the ribbon vertices nearest the cup used as attachment point A; likewise for the crown.
Radius (m) around attachment A used to average rest normals; scale-dependent on a metre-scale human asset.
Fallback flap normal = +Z; assumes +Z is the asset front.
Flips the flap normal to face +Z; assumes +Z is the asset front.
Hang direction of a fallen flap: -Y gravity (Y-up asset) with a 0.2 forward (+Z) lean "so it clears the body" (comment l.337).
Cup membership uses the +1 side mask of the chest regions (left = +x convention).
Cup membership threshold: max(chest-left mask, chest-right mask) must exceed 0.01.
strapReach mirrors a point across the x = 0 plane: assumes the garment is symmetric about x = 0.
Outward-normal test for a grabbed strap: normal must point away from the axis (x=0, z=p.z+0.03) "behind the strap" (comment l.599); the 0.03 m offset is a coordinate tied to this asset.
Cup panel normal flipped to +Z; assumes +Z is the asset front.
Cup pull: maximum outward (normal) lift in metres.
Cup pull tension coupling coefficient into the chest regions.

subjectLiterals.literal: The delivered garment occupies the upper torso
subjectLiterals.meaning: Comment documenting why the y band below exists.
Torso face filter: triangles whose max y < 1.19 m are dropped from skin contact (below the garment).
Torso face filter: triangles whose min y > 1.65 m are dropped from skin contact (above the garment).
Search radius (m) around a garment vertex for candidate skin faces: 0.14 for strap vertices, 0.055 otherwise; scale-dependent.
Rest clearance clamp [0.0008, 0.02] m; 0.0008 equals SKIN_GUARD.floor (garment.mjs l.49 comment: "the contact step's own minimum rest gap").
Maximum face-walk steps while locating the nearest skin patch.
ROUND_CHEST.plateau: full weight within this distance (m) of the breast apex; value tuned on this chest.
ROUND_CHEST.reach: weight reaches zero at this distance (m) from the apex.
ROUND_CHEST.wallDepth: full weight down to this depth (m) behind the apex.
ROUND_CHEST.wallFade: fade length (m) beyond wallDepth.
ROUND_CHEST.midline: zero weight within this |x| (m) of the body midline x = 0.
ROUND_CHEST.midlineFade: ramp (m) beyond midline; comment l.25-26: narrower than ~45 mm shears the sternum triangles past the topology guard on this mesh.
ROUND_CHEST.regions: region ids that receive round masks.
ROUND_CHEST.suffix: appended to the authored mask attribute name.
Apex search considers vertices painted at weight >= 0.3 in the authored mask.
Apex = front-most vertex; +Z is the asset front (doc comment l.48).
Depth behind the apex along -Z.
Medial fade measured from the x = 0 midline of the shared first-mesh frame.
REGION_IDS: fixed soft-tissue region vocabulary accepted by createSoftRig.

PADS: contact-pad [radius, depth] in metres per region family (chest .022/.0035, hips .025/.004, abdomen .025/.0005, waist .015/.0012, cheek .014/0); comment on l.21: "Artistic ... in the normalized metre-scale asset".
Build stamp exposed as window.namiStudio.build (contract build stamp guard-1).
Camera fov 30 deg, near .01 m, far 30 m.
Orbit target (0, 0.88, 0); y = 0.88 m is the model-space height chosen for this character (meaning beyond that is unverified).
Orbit distance limits (m).
Floor shadow disc radius 0.28 m; relation to this character's stance is unverified.
Floor shadow ellipse scale; y -0.001 m lifts it just under the floor plane.
Hard-coded GLB path relative to the served root.
Hard-coded soft-body sidecar path relative to the served root.
Hard-coded skin mesh name looked up in the GLB.
Hard-coded garment mesh name used to read the authored cup masks.
Hard-coded garment mesh name passed to createGarments.
UI labels (Vietnamese) for the OUTFITS ids.
Hard-coded name fragment of the real animation clip required in the GLB.
Camera view front.
Camera view quarter (default view).
Camera view profile.
Camera view rear.
Camera view torso: framed at y = 1.25 m on the chest/garment region of this asset.
Camera view hips (behind): framed at y = 0.94 m.
Camera view face: framed at y = 1.61 m; used for the cheek-* regions (focusRegion).
focusRegion: hips-* regions use view hips, cheek-* use face, everything else torso.
Outfit ids the UI buttons iterate (must equal garment.mjs OUTFITS).
Views that cannot show the garment; setOutfit switches to torso for them.
